I replied to Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **ticket #4092**.

That comes from Ilse in #north-random on Oct 13, a channel Dana is in. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub there, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because the Polycom resets. I added that warning to the reply too.

Earlier, in their direct message with me, Dana guessed the ticket would end up as OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep that private. I didn't use it or mention it in the channel. It was only a guess, and Ilse's message gives the actual ticket number.
